zh: 字符要按 Unicode 码点计数：一个表情这类非 BMP 字符在 JSON 里可能写成两个 \u 转义（代理对），但它只算一个字符。
先把输入的 JSON 字符串完整解码成码点序列，取最后一个码点、一个空格、倒数第二个码点拼成新串，再按题目规定的规范 ASCII JSON 格式重新编码。
解码时处理 \" \\ \/ \b \f \n \r \t 和 \uXXXX，高代理后面紧跟低代理时合并成一个码点。编码时双引号和反斜线加反斜线转义，五个常用控制字符用短转义，其余可打印 ASCII 原样输出，其他字符一律用小写四位 \uXXXX，非 BMP 字符拆成小写的代理对，两侧保留双引号。
en: Count characters as Unicode code points: a non-BMP character such as an emoji may be written in JSON as two \u escapes (a surrogate pair), but it is a single character.

Decode the input JSON string completely into code points, build the new string from the last code point, a space, and the second-to-last code point, then encode it in the canonical ASCII JSON form the problem specifies.

When decoding, handle \" \\ \/ \b \f \n \r \t and \uXXXX, merging a high surrogate immediately followed by a low surrogate into one code point. When encoding, escape double quotes and backslashes with a backslash, use the short escapes for the five common control characters, output other printable ASCII as is, write every other character as a lowercase four-digit \uXXXX, split non-BMP characters into a lowercase surrogate pair, and keep the surrounding double quotes.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Take the last character and the second-to-last character, join them with a space, and output the unique ASCII JSON encoding.

## Proof of correctness

Python string indexing counts Unicode code points, so -1 and -2 are exactly the two required characters. After inserting one space, JSON escaping changes only the representation, not the resulting string.

## Complexity

O(n) input time and space, output length O(1).
